findings.title: DiagSpill SCTP kernel exposure
findings.description: Potentially vulnerable kernel 7.0.12-linuxkit with SCTP diagnostics reachable (sctp: loaded; sctp_diag: built-in). Local exploitation needs no capability or unprivileged user namespace.
findings.evidence: Potentially vulnerable kernel 7.0.12-linuxkit with SCTP diagnostics reachable (sctp: loaded; sctp_diag: built-in)
findings.extraction_notes: Extracted from LinPEAS kernel module vulnerability scan section.

findings.extraction_notes: Running kernel 7.0.12-linuxkit falls within the affected range.
